resources.string: ActionBox organizes incoming notifications (like WhatsApp messages, texts, and emails) into actionable items. To do that, it needs permission to read notification content.\n\nYour notification content stays on this device and is never uploaded anywhere — classification runs entirely on-device. (The free plan shows ads, and Pro purchases go through Google Play; neither ever sees your notification content.) You can revoke notification access at any time from system settings.
